page.layout: One printed page, title page, all centred. Lines run from the top title down to the printer's imprint at the foot. No running head, no page number printed, no notes in the margins.
page.notes: The handwritten "23." at the top right corner is manuscript, not printed, so it is left out. The Greek word after "Placida" is set in small type and is uncertain; I have marked it [?]. "BRENNVVALDIO" is printed with VV for W and is kept as printed. The imprint date is printed in Roman numerals as "M DC XCII" (1692) with a space, kept as printed.
